blocks.title: What paint correction is, and what it takes out of your paint.
body: Paint correction is **machine polishing**. Swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation and water spots sit in the clear coat, the clear layer over your color. We polish them out of that layer by machine, and the gloss comes back.

Wax sits on top of the paint and washes off in weeks, and the marks under it are still there when it does. Correction does not cover anything up. The marks are **polished out of the clear coat**. There are three ways to get it:
checks: **One-step polish.** A single polishing stage for light swirls and dull paint. Sold as a package with a starting price.
**Multi-stage correction.** More than one stage, for heavier swirls and oxidation. Quoted per vehicle after we see the paint.
**With a ceramic coating.** Paint correction is included in every coating package, done right before the coating goes on.

blocks.title: What correction fixes, and what it cannot.
blocks.intro: Polishing works on the clear coat that is there. Here is where the line sits, so you know what to expect before you book.

items.title: Swirl marks and wash marks
items.body: The fine scratches that years of washing leave behind, easiest to see on dark paint in direct sun. They sit in the clear coat, which is the layer a machine polish works on.

items.title: Rock chips
items.body: A chip is a spot where the paint is gone. Polishing cannot put paint back, so a chip will still be there after correction.

items.title: Light scratches
items.body: Scratches that are in the clear coat and have not gone through it. The one-step polish in Polish & Protect removes roughly 60 to 70% of light swirls and scratches. A multi-stage correction goes further.

items.title: Scratches through the clear coat
items.body: A scratch that has cut through the clear coat is deeper than polishing reaches. We point these out when we inspect the paint, before any work starts.

items.title: Oxidation and water spots
items.body: Dull, faded paint and the marks water leaves when it dries on a panel. The 2021 Chevy Silverado 2500HD in our photos came in with heavy oxidation and water spots. Both polished out.

items.title: Failed clear coat
items.body: When the clear coat itself has failed, there is nothing sound left to polish. **Correction is not repainting**, and we will say so plainly if that is what we find on your vehicle.

blocks.title: Six steps from free quote to corrected, protected paint.
blocks.intro: The polisher is only one part of the job. Here is what happens, in order.

steps.title: Start with a free quote
steps.body: Tell us what you drive and send photos of the paint. A one-step polish has a starting price. For heavier paint we build a real number for your vehicle.

steps.title: Drop-off or valet pickup
steps.body: Correction is shop work, done by appointment in Clinton Township. Bring the vehicle to us, or ask about our [pick-up and drop-off valet service](/mobile-detailing/): we pick it up and bring it back.

steps.title: Inspection under shop lighting
steps.body: We look over your paint under shop lighting and note the swirls, scratches and any existing damage. You hear which marks will polish out and which will not before we touch the car.

steps.title: Wash and decontamination
steps.body: A full decontamination wash: iron and tar removal, then a clay treatment to pull out the embedded grit a normal wash leaves behind.

steps.title: Machine polish
steps.body: Swirls, light scratches and oxidation are machine polished out of the clear coat. Light defects get a one-step polish. Heavier paint gets a multi-stage correction, and Matt, our lead technician, handles the heaviest of it.

steps.title: Protection
steps.body: Polish & Protect is sealed for 6 months, and the Luxury Refresh gets a sealant on the paint. With a ceramic coating package, every panel is wiped down and the coating goes on here.

faq.q: How much does paint correction cost?
faq.a:
A one-step polish has set starting prices. Polish & Protect, an exterior package, is from $389.99. The Luxury Refresh, a full interior and exterior detail with a one-step polish, is from $549.99. Both are for a coupe or sedan in average condition, and SUVs and trucks are quoted for their size.

A multi-stage correction is quoted per vehicle after we see the paint. Text us photos or use the quote form on this page and we will give you a real number. Financing is available through Affirm and Klarna.

faq.q: How long does paint correction take?
faq.a:
Polish & Protect takes about 4.5 to 5 hours. The Luxury Refresh, which includes a full interior detail, takes about 7 hours. Larger vehicles take longer.

A multi-stage correction takes longer, and how much longer depends on the paint. We tell you how long when we quote your vehicle. If you would rather not arrange a ride, our pick-up and drop-off valet picks the vehicle up and brings it back when the work is done.

faq.q: What is the difference between a one-step polish and a multi-stage correction?
faq.a:
A one-step polish is a single polishing stage for light swirls and dull paint. It is what you get in Polish & Protect, where it removes roughly 60 to 70% of light swirls and scratches, and in the Luxury Refresh.

A multi-stage correction, which you may hear us call a 2 step, is for heavier swirls and oxidation that one stage will not clear. It is quoted per vehicle after we see the paint, and we will tell you straight which one your paint needs.

faq.q: Will paint correction remove every scratch?
faq.a:
No, and we would rather say so now than at pickup. The one-step polish in Polish & Protect removes roughly 60 to 70% of light swirls and scratches. A multi-stage correction takes out more.

Rock chips, scratches that have gone through the clear coat and failed clear coat are outside what polishing can do. Correction is not repainting. We look over the paint under shop lighting before any work starts and tell you which marks will come out and which will stay.

faq.q: Can you do paint correction at my home?
faq.a:
No. Paint correction is shop work. Machine polishing needs enclosed bays and controlled lighting, and a driveway gives us dust and weather to work against.

If getting to Clinton Township is the obstacle, use our pick-up and drop-off valet: we pick the vehicle up, correct it at the shop and bring it back. Mobile detailing is still available for interior details and Wash & Seal.

faq.q: Do I need a ceramic coating after paint correction?
faq.a:
You do not need one. Polish & Protect is sealed for 6 months, and the Luxury Refresh includes a sealant on the paint.

A coating is for when you want the corrected finish protected for years, not months. Our [ceramic coating packages](/ceramic-coating/) run 1, 3 and 5 years, and paint correction is included in every one. If you know you want a coating, book the coating and the correction comes with it.

faq.q: How do I keep swirl marks from coming back?
faq.a:
Mostly by changing how the car gets washed. Brush-style automatic washes put swirls into any finish, corrected or not, and wiping dust off dry paint drags grit across the clear coat. Touchless washes are fine, and so is a gentle hand wash.

A ceramic coating makes washing easier. Grime does not grip a coated surface, so a rinse and a gentle wash does the job.

quote.lede: No pressure and no guessing off a price list. Tell us what you drive and send a photo of the paint. We will tell you what will polish out, what will not, and how much correction it takes. Sometimes that is the one-step polish.
